| DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-018 | decision record (PLT library, created in `rwb_asset`) | rule id, rule version, inputs reference, holding start date, threshold, outcome, decided at | Write through the library, before the asset changes |
| DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036 | timer (P3) | the two clocks | Not read and not written: durable workflow timers, and the row is P3's (BR4) |
| DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219 | `v_ace_npa_asset` (P1) | asset_ref, asset_key, asset_code, transfer_in_type, from_segment, book_value and the rest | Not read: no `v_ace_*` grant (BR6) |
| DF-CAS-001 to DF-CAS-023 | recovery_case (P3) | id, case_no, status, stage_code, route state | Not read as a table: the state arrives on the contract |
| DF-REF-001 to DF-REF-015 | rule_row (P7) | rule_id, rule_version, route_set, from_state, event_code and the rest | Not read: the rows arrive in the package |

Field IDs are those of the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8 and of the legacy Data table. The FSD S5 and TSD S5 files that would carry the rest of the field set are not in `_work/msr/extract` for this WP, so the asset columns are the ten the dictionary gives and the remaining fields carry the placeholder (GAP-2855; ASM-4726). **No new table, no new column and no migration**: the existing columns are written, and `decision_record` and `idempotency_key` are library objects created by the library's own migration (DP-03).

**No personal data.** Rows carry identifiers, codes, amounts, dates and a rule version; no name, address, contact value or identity number enters the asset, the record, a log, a workflow input or a provision input, and every fixture is synthetic.

##### 12. Contract

###### 12.1 REST operations provided

Owner rwb-asset (S5); base `/api/recovery/asset/v1` (DP-13). This story supplies the behaviour behind the two reads whose shapes RWB-S5-E3023-CON declares.

| Method | Path | Documented shape | Access | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/assets` | AssetPage out, filtered by type, status and region, paginated | Asset and disposal, right R, scope applied | Not applicable |
| GET | `/assets/{assetId}` | Asset of status 200 out, with its holding age, its cost to date, its next provision step date and its listing references | Asset and disposal, right R, scope applied | Not applicable |

The errors are 400, 401, 403 with MSG-P4-002, 404, 422 with MSG-GEN-001 and 503 when the record library or a consumed contract does not answer. The operation IDs are the ones the CON baseline fixes and are not redefined here. `POST /assets/{assetId}/listings` and `POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds` belong to the pricing and auction stories and are not built here.

###### 12.2 REST operations consumed

| Method | Path | Owner | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| The read of DP06 Collateral and assets (operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2856; ASM-4730)) | `/api/recovery/source-data/v1` | P1 rwb-source-data | The asset fact: stock date, book value, asset type, transfer-in type and segment, with the freshness stamp; faked |
| `GET /cases/{caseId}` family (read) | `/api/recovery/case/v1` | P3 rwb-case | The case state, the case reference and the title status; read only, faked |
| The case-move answer (operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2856; ASM-4730)) | rwb-case (P3) | P3 rwb-case | The move `ASSET_HELD` with the rule and its version; on the workflow boundary it is the stage outcome the parent applies; faked |

Every row is one hop with a 2 s timeout, a GET retried once with jitter and a breaker per downstream (ADR-020). The three rows are class C dependencies in fact that the plan's C row does not carry (GAP-2856; ASM-4730). The cost-of-carry request is a Temporal activity, not a REST row (12.5).

###### 12.3 Events published

None. Slide 19 OUT gives rwb-asset `AssetTakenOn` and `AssetSold`, neither of them a holding event, and slide 43 lists event 22 and no second event. The provision input leaves on the Finance provision feed, not on a Kafka topic, so this step writes no outbox row and a build that adds an event fails the absence test (GAP-2856; ASM-4727).

###### 12.4 Events consumed

None. Slide 19 IN gives rwb-asset `JudgmentRecorded`, `AuctionResult` and `ProceedsMatched`, none of which starts this step; it starts from the confirmation the parent forwards and from its own timer. This story holds no consumer group, no subscription and no inbox row.

###### 12.5 Workflows and activities

| Name | Type | Task queue | Contract element |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AssetDisposalWorkflow` | Workflow, one execution per case per stage, child of `CaseWorkflow`, continues-as-new across the years of a holding | `rwb-asset` in `rwb-recovery` | Input: the case, the route, the asset reference and the package in force; signals: the confirmation, the case state, the package in force; timers: the holding age and provision step clocks |
| `applyHoldingStep` | Activity, the confirmation step | `rwb-asset` | The case and the confirmation in; the rule ID with its version, the holding start date, the next step date, the cost to date and the case move out |
| `applyProvisionStep` | Activity, the provision step | `rwb-asset` | The case, the threshold and the asset in; the rule ID with its version, the step applied, the feed reference and the next threshold out |
| `requestCostOfCarry` | Activity on the owner's queue | `rwb-payment` | The case, the asset, the month, the book value and the rule version in; the posted amount and its reference out (ASM-4729) |

No child workflow for the case and none for the money exists in this service, and no activity is registered on another service's queue. The activity names are a target design choice that no source fixes (ASM-4735).

###### 12.6 Schedules

None. The clocks are durable timers inside the workflow, not Schedules, and this story owns no Schedule and no Quartz job (BR3). The service's single Schedule is JOB-19 Re-appraisal monthly, which belongs to RWB-S5-E3026-APP (Architecture v5 slide 44; Ownership Map jobs JOB-19).

###### 12.7 Tables owned

| Table | Owner | Note |
|---|---|---|
| asset | S5 (`rwb_asset`) | The held asset; this story reads the columns of §11 and writes the holding facts the DB story publishes |
| decision_record | PLT library, created in `rwb_asset` | The local hash-linked record of the rule outcome (DP-03) |
| idempotency_key | PLT library, created in `rwb_asset` | The key of the repeated confirmation and the threshold it holds |

Not owned and never read as a table: `recovery_case`, `timer` and `task` (P3), `collateral` and every `v_ace_*` view (P1), `document` (P5), `notice` (P6), `proceeds` (P8), `decision_log_entry`, `rule_row` and `rule_package` (P7), `listing` and `asset_sale` (S5, later stories'). No foreign key leaves the schema (DP-01, DP-05).

###### 12.8 Contract fakes

| Fake | Documented answer | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| rwb-source-data data-product fake | The asset facts of asset `AST-2026-000511` with stock date, book value, type and transfer-in type; a stale product with its date; no answer beyond 2 s | AC1, X5 |
| rwb-case case-state fake | The states `ASSET_ON_BOOKS`, `ASSET_HELD` and `DISPOSAL_PAUSED_DEVIATION` with title status `clear`, `under_transfer` and `encumbered` | AC2, X3, X4 |
| rwb-case case-move fake | The move `ASSET_HELD` accepted and refused | AC2, X3 |
| rwb-payment cost-of-carry fake | The monthly charge recorded with its posting reference; no answer beyond 2 s | AC1, AC2, X5 |
| Finance provision feed fake | The provision input accepted with its reference, and the feed refusing it | AC1, X6 |
| rwb-decision rule-package fake | The DISPOSAL package at its version with R-DIS-06 and R-DIS-09 | AC1, AC2 |
| Local decision-record stub (`RWB-PLT-E1027-CON`) | A healthy chain and a stopped chain | AC3, X1 |
| gateway-bff composite route fake | The merged SCR-21 and SCR-22 answer for case `RC-2026-000511` | AC1 |

The fakes are test-only and are replaced in SIT. The operation names of the rwb-source-data read, of the case-move answer and of the feed carry the placeholder until their owners confirm them (GAP-2856; ASM-4730, ASM-4735).

###### 12.9 Call-type summary

| Call type | Count | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| REST | 2 provided, 3 consumed | The two asset reads on `/api/recovery/asset/v1`; the source-data read, the case read and the move answer; one hop, 2 s |
| Kafka | 0 published, 0 consumed | No event on this step; the provision input leaves on the feed |
| Temporal | 1 workflow, 3 activities | `AssetDisposalWorkflow` with two steps on `rwb-asset` and `requestCostOfCarry` on `rwb-payment`; two durable timers; no Schedule |
| File | None | No file is read, built or delivered here |

##### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** `th.co.scb.ace.workbench.recovery.asset`, module `holding`, package `th.co.scb.ace.workbench.recovery.asset.holding`; front end `src/modules/recovery/asset/AssetHolding.tsx`, the fragment the two screens embed, read only.

| DP | Legacy marker | Microservice pattern | Dependency added |
|---|---|---|---|
| DP-03 | DecisionLogWriter, decision log | Local decision-record library and topic `rwb.decision-record.v1` | H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON |
| DP-05 | AceSourceQuery, `v_ace_*`, account_ext | Read through rwb-source-data's contract or the service's own ACE views | none |
| DP-13 | `/api/recovery/v1` | `/api/recovery/<short>/v1` | none |
| DP-19 | Screen, ace-web | gateway-bff composite route | H RWB-PLT-N001-CON |

DP-05 applies only as a prohibition: no `v_ace_*` grant, no ACE view and no ACE table is read here (ASM-4731). DP-03 is the transaction rule of both steps. DP-13 moves the base and nothing else. DP-19 is how the two screens reach this service. DP-10 is held as a prohibition and not listed: the legacy clocks were scheduled work and are durable workflow timers in the target, so no Schedule library and no job row is introduced (BR3).

**Dependencies.** The two H rows the table adds are already in the plan's build list. The three consumed reads and the rwb-payment activity are C dependencies in fact while the plan's C row is None, so the story builds on their fakes on Day 1 and the absence is recorded (GAP-2856; ASM-4729, ASM-4730).

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| `AssetDisposalWorkflow` holding branch | Workflow | Waits for the confirmation, arms the two clocks, fires the provision step and reports to the parent |
| `applyHoldingStep` | Activity | Reads the fact and the case, evaluates R-DIS-06, writes the record, arms the clocks, requests the charge, updates the asset, answers the move |
| `applyProvisionStep` | Activity | Evaluates R-DIS-09 at the threshold, writes the record, applies the step, sends the input and rearms |
| `HoldingAgeEvaluator` | Service | The rule evaluation against the package in force, with the thresholds read as its values |
| `HoldingDecisionRecordWriter` | Library adapter | Writes the record with the rule ID and version before any change and refuses the step when the write fails (DP-03) |
| `HoldingClockArmer` | Workflow helper | Arms, holds and rearms the two durable timers across Continue-As-New |
| `CostOfCarryClient` | Activity client | The monthly request on `rwb-payment`, with its timeout and no posting of its own |
| `ProvisionFeedClient` | Client | Hands the provision input to the feed with its reference, its retry and its refusal path |
| `CaseStateClient` | Client | The case state read and the move answer of rwb-case, one hop, 2 s |
| `HoldingWriter` | Repository | Updates `asset` with the holding facts in one transaction, with the idempotency row and the optimistic lock |
| `AssetController` | Controller | The two reads, the right, the pagination and the problem mapping of 400 to 503 |
| `AssetHolding` | React component | Shows the age, the cost to date and the next step on the two screens, read only |

**Database and migrations.** No Flyway file. `asset` arrives with the DB story, and the record and the idempotency key are library objects created in `rwb_asset` by the library's migration (DP-03). The model gives no age, next-date or cost column, so the age and the next date are workflow and reference facts (GAP-2855; ASM-4726).

**Configuration.** The DISPOSAL package at its version in force with R-DIS-06 and R-DIS-09; the thresholds, the percentages and the rate as its values and as reference data, tested through the test profile (BR5). Which date opens the clock is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2855; ASM-4726), so the value is read and never hard-coded. The capability area "Asset and disposal" and right R are access rows of rwb-access. The 2 s budget and the single hop are ADR-020.

**Build steps**

1. The holding branch and its input record, registered on `rwb-asset` as the stage child, with the confirmation as trigger.
2. `CaseStateClient` and the fakes with the budget, the breaker and the no-answer path (AC2, X5).
3. `HoldingAgeEvaluator` with R-DIS-06, the title condition and the no-fire path (AC2, X4).
4. `HoldingDecisionRecordWriter` against the stub with the failed-write path (AC3, X1).
5. `HoldingClockArmer` with a shortened test interval, a Continue-As-New mid-hold and a redeploy mid-hold (AC2, BR3).
6. `requestCostOfCarry` and `HoldingWriter` with one transaction and the idempotency row (AC1, AC2, X7).
7. `applyProvisionStep` with R-DIS-09, the threshold test, the record, the input and the rearm (AC1, X6).
8. `ProvisionFeedClient` with the retry, the refusal and the task-after-limit path (X6).
9. `CaseMoveAnswer` and the parent signal with the `ASSET_HELD` move (AC2).
10. `AssetController` and `AssetHolding` with the right, the pagination and the problem mapping (AC1).
11. The boundary test: nothing outside `rwb_asset`, no `v_ace_*` read, no write to `rwb_case`, `rwb_decision`, `rwb_payment` or `timer` (X8, BR4, BR6).

**Feature flag.** `rwb.asset.holding-v1`; off means the step holds the confirmation, arms no clock and answers no move, and the take-on and sale stories are unaffected.

**Done when.** The tests of §16 pass, the step runs from a synthetic confirmation, R-DIS-06 produces its record, its clocks, its charge and its move, R-DIS-09 produces its record, its input and its rearm, a repeat writes once, a forced record failure changes nothing, a redeploy mid-hold keeps both clocks, no `recovery_case` row, no `timer` row and no `v_ace_*` read exists in the build, and the two screens answer through the composite route.

##### 14. Validation and messages

| ID | When | Message |
|---|---|---|
| MSG-S5-001 | Carried from the legacy set of this key; it names the floor and the approval limit, which are the pricing story's, so no path here raises it | The floor is {pct} of fair market value, below the {limit} this level may approve. |
| MSG-S5-002 | Carried from the legacy set; it names the age of an appraisal, which is the re-appraisal story's, so no path here raises it | The appraisal is from {date}, more than a year ago. Order a new one before pricing. |
| MSG-GEN-001 | A required field of a request or of the asset fact is absent or invalid (X3, X4) | Enter {field}. |
| MSG-P4-002 | A role without the Asset and disposal right reads the list or the asset (X2) | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. |
| MSG-P7-003 | The record cannot be written before the asset changes (X1) | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. |

The five message IDs are the legacy message set of RWB-E3-023, copied unchanged; no message is reworded and no new one is added. The feed refusal of X6 has no message ID in any source available to this file, so it is logged with its reference and shown as a task (GAP-2856).

##### 15. Screens and states

SCR-21 Asset list in its loading and list states and SCR-22 Asset record in its take-on, held, listed and sold states are served through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19). The route calls rwb-asset for the asset and its holding facts, rwb-case for the case and its route state and rwb-source-data for the ACE asset fact; this story fixes the rwb-asset answers only, and the route specification and the screen field list belong to RWB-PLT-N001-CON.

The states this story produces are the held state of SCR-22 — the age in days, the cost to date, the next step date and the rule version of the last step — and the refusal and failure states it shows: refused with MSG-P4-002 and not recorded with MSG-P7-003. The take-on, listed and sold states belong to the take-on and sale stories and are read from the same route.

| TC ID | Covers | Level | Data |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-E3-023-01 | AC1 | Component | Asset `AST-2026-000511` for case `RC-2026-000511` with stock date, book value and title cleared; the age, the step, the record and the feed input asserted on the fakes with a shortened interval |
| TC-E3-023-02 | AC2 | Component | Case `RC-2026-000511` at `ASSET_ON_BOOKS` with title cleared; both clocks armed, the charge answered and the `ASSET_HELD` move sent |

The five legacy cases are the legacy cases in their legacy order, with the Level column added: `System` maps to `Component` because every path runs on its fakes. The full test, with its Given, When and Then, is in Recovery Workbench Test Cases v7.xlsx, tab Story test cases, under the same ID; the `-ITG` copies belong to the wave 2 harness.

##### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: the thresholds, the percentages, the rate, the lists and the rule rows stay data, reference data or the package, never a constant, a default or a branch.
- No personal data in the asset, a provision or charge input, a workflow input or a log: identifiers, codes, amounts, dates and a rule version only; fixtures are synthetic.
- ACE data only through the owner's contract: no `v_ace_*` grant and no ACE table, and a build that adds one fails the boundary test (DP-05).
- The case stays with rwb-case and the money with rwb-payment: no `recovery_case` row, no `timer` row, no posting, no balance and no ledger row here (BR4, BR7, BR8).
- The clocks are workflow timers: no Quartz row, no job table, no Schedule and no second clock for the same asset.
- The decision is recorded before the change; a build that changes the asset first fails the review (DP-03).
- One base, one topic, one queue and one login per service; no document or test names another service's base, topic or queue as its own (DP-13, DP-14).
- No retired element is reintroduced: no monolith base `/api/recovery/v1`, no data-lake extract of the step and no shared scheduler.

**Change log.** D-RCV-60, 22 November 2026: contract baseline of the asset stock balance of rwb-asset, split from RWB-E3-024. It fixes the two reads on `/api/recovery/asset/v1` (DP-13) with the `AssetStockBalance` element, the confirmation operation and its `StockBalanceConfirmation` request, the owner-role and as-at fields, the consumed rwb-source-data and rwb-case rows, the decision-record element of DP-03, the tables, the fakes and the absence tests. The confirmation has no operation in any source and the figure has no object in the TSD, so both are carried as placeholders with their assumptions (GAP-2861; ASM-4743). Tool: T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash.

##### 1. Story

As a **tech lead**, I want **the published contract baseline of the asset stock balance of rwb-asset — the two reads on `/api/recovery/asset/v1`, the `AssetStockBalance` element with its owner and as-at fields, the confirmation request and answer, the consumed rwb-source-data and rwb-case rows, the decision-record element, the tables and the fakes**, so that **the app story, the two screens, the reporting reader and the wave 2 harness build against one fixed, testable contract on Day 1 and a count, a total, an owner role, a list value or an answer shape can never drift between rwb-asset, rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-access without a failing build**.

This is the contract slice of legacy RWB-E3-024. It owns the surface and nothing behind it: the three operations, the two elements, the closed vocabulary, the consumed rows, the error set, the fakes and the absence tests. It owns none of the legacy criteria, which stay word for word with RWB-S5-E3024-APP, and it writes no code, no migration and no table.

##### 2. Business rationale

Contract-first REST with one hop and a 2 s timeout is the decoupling decision (DP-11, ADR-020). The legacy feature of RWB-E3-024 read the ACE NPA asset, the ACE account and the case across the `recovery` schema in one query, with the stock balance owned by no one. The target splits the boundaries: rwb-source-data owns the ACE asset and account facts, rwb-case owns the case and its route states, rwb-access owns the role matrix, and rwb-asset owns the `asset` rows and the balance computed from them. Each boundary is now a contract another team builds against, so each has to be fixed before the app story starts: the balance element and its grouping, the vocabulary of `LOV-HOLDING`, `LOV-SEGMENT`, `LOV-ASSET-TYPE` and `LOV-TRANSFER-IN`, the confirmation request, the fact the rwb-source-data contract answers, the case state of rwb-case, the owner role of the access matrix and the record of the decision.

The baseline also fixes the naming the checks require: schema `rwb_asset`, base `/api/recovery/asset/v1`, topic `rwb.asset.events.v1` with its retry and `.dlt` topics, task queue `rwb-asset` in namespace `rwb-recovery` and Java package `th.co.scb.ace.workbench.recovery.asset` (Architecture v5 slide 19 notes). It records that rwb-asset holds no `v_ace_*` grant and no grant on `rwb_case`, so DP-05 is declared as a prohibition and the ACE fact is consumed on the owner's contract only.

Three points are carried as gaps and assumptions rather than decided quietly: no source names a write operation for the confirmation, so its path is a placeholder (GAP-2861; ASM-4743); no source says which figure the number is, so the count with the two totals is the default (GAP-2861; ASM-4744); and the TSD declares no balance object, so the figure is a computed answer and not a table (GAP-2861; ASM-4745).

##### 3. Preconditions

- The service template and the naming library are available (RWB-PLT-TPL, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON), so the base, the topic, the queue and the element names follow the platform rule rather than a local choice.
- The platform error envelope, the pagination and filter convention and the `Idempotency-Key` rule are the platform baseline (Architecture v5 slide 11); where this document narrows them it does so explicitly.
- The ownership of the objects is taken from the Ownership Map only: `listing` and `asset_sale` are S5's, `recovery_case` and `assignment` are P3's, `proceeds` is P8's, `document` is P5's, `decision_log_entry` and `rule_row` are P7's. This document never declares another service's table or operation as its own, and it records that `asset` has no Ownership Map row while Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1 give it to S5 (GAP-2861; ASM-4745).
- The rwb-source-data data-product contract of DP06 Collateral and assets and the rwb-case state row are published with their fakes, so the consumed rows name a real owner document; they are not in this story's contract-dependency row, which is None (GAP-2861; ASM-4746).
- The rwb-access role matrix publishes the role codes RW-NPAMGR and RW-HEADNPA with their Asset and disposal rights and scopes, so the owner field of the answer resolves to a role and never to a person (GAP-2861; ASM-4744).
- The DISPOSAL rule package and its rule rows for R-DIS-01, R-DIS-02 and R-DIS-03 are governed in rwb-decision (P7); this baseline names them and declares none of them.
- The `asset` and `listing` tables and their columns arrive with the DB story of this service; this baseline declares shapes and creates no table, no column and no migration.
- No build dependency: this story is Day 1 by rule (Template and Rules §R5.7).

##### 4. Flow

1. Draft the OpenAPI 3.1 document of rwb-asset for this feature: the two reads with their filters, rights and error responses, and the confirmation with its request, its answer and its idempotency.
2. Fix the `AssetStockBalance` element: the scope, the as-at date, the owner role, the per-`holding_status` count, book-value total and holding-cost total, the record reference and the package version.
3. Fix the `StockBalanceConfirmation` request: the scope, the as-at date and the officer reference, with its required flags.
4. Fix the consumed rows: the rwb-source-data data-product read with its freshness stamp, and the rwb-case state and move rows, marking every field the sources do not give with the placeholder.
5. Record the decision-record element of DP-03, written before the figure is confirmed.
6. Record the closed vocabulary of the four lists, the naming baseline and the rule that no value is a constant of the code.
7. Publish the contract tables of section 12 and the fakes of 12.8.
8. Add the contract tests: schema validation, the additive rule, the vocabulary, the shapes, the `Idempotency-Key` rule, the error envelope, the absence of a `v_ace_*` read, of a `recovery_case` write and of a balance table, the drift between a fake and the document, and the absence of an event.
9. Tag the baseline and hand it to RWB-S5-E3024-APP, the two screens, the reporting reader and the wave 2 harness.

##### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | A request or a response body fails schema validation | The build fails on the schema lint; a deployed service answers 400 or 500 with the error envelope | MSG-GEN-001 | AC1, AC3 |
| X2 | A property is renamed or removed within major version 1 | The contract test fails; the change needs a new major version | None | AC1, AC2 |
| X3 | A fake drifts from the document | The drift test fails the build and the merge is blocked | None | AC5 |
| X4 | A consumed row or a designed element has fields the sources do not give | The row carries the placeholder, the gap and the assumption, and the fake is derived from the published document | None | AC3, AC4 |
| X5 | A value outside `LOV-HOLDING`, `LOV-SEGMENT`, `LOV-ASSET-TYPE` or `LOV-TRANSFER-IN` appears in the document or an example | The vocabulary test fails the build | None | AC2 |
| X6 | The document declares another service's operation as provided, a `v_ace_*` view, a `recovery_case` or `assignment` property, a `rule_row` or a balance table | The review fails the baseline; the boundary test fails the build | None | AC5 |
| X7 | The document declares an event, a second topic or a Schedule | The absence test fails the build | None | AC5 |
| X8 | The rights of an operation are not the ones TSD S5 T-A.1 and T6.1 declare | The access test fails the build | MSG-P4-002 | AC4 |

|---|---|
| Independent | No build dependency; reads the platform envelopes, the Ownership Map and the published contracts of rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-access only |
| Negotiable | The element names beyond the ones the sources give, the example values and the fake fixtures are settled in the baseline review; the operations, the lists, the base, the topic and the queue are fixed by the target architecture |
| Valuable | Unblocks RWB-S5-E3024-APP, the two screens, the reporting reader and the wave 2 harness on Day 1 |

| Testable | Every criterion is tested against the artefact, not against a business outcome |

##### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | The balance is declared as a computed element of this service's own `asset` rows and of no other owner's data: the count, the book-value total and the holding-cost total per `holding_status`, with the scope and the as-at date | TSD S5 T3.1 and T3.2; Architecture v5 slide 41; DP-01; ASM-4745 |
| BR2 | The decision record is declared as an element written before the figure is confirmed, through the local library on the shared topic; a failed write changes nothing | DP-03; TSD S5 T2; legacy RWB-E3-024 AC1 and AC4 |
| BR3 | The ACE asset fact stays with rwb-source-data: the contract declares the data-product read as consumed, declares no `v_ace_*` property and describes no ACE table read of rwb-asset | DP-05; Architecture v5 slides 29, 37 and 45; ASM-4746 |
| BR4 | The case move is answered and not written: the contract declares the state read and the answer, and declares no `recovery_case` or `assignment` property and no case row write | Ownership Map (recovery_case and assignment owner P3) |
| BR5 | The owner of the balance is a role code of the access matrix, with a scope, and never a person, a user identifier or a name | FSD S5 A2.6.3.3; TSD S5 T6.1; Template and Rules §R7.2 (s17) |
| BR6 | A POST declares the `Idempotency-Key` and stores its answer; a GET declares none | Architecture v5 slide 11; TSD S5 T-A.2 |
| BR7 | The vocabulary is closed: `LOV-HOLDING`, `LOV-SEGMENT`, `LOV-ASSET-TYPE` and `LOV-TRANSFER-IN` are published as enumerated values and no list value is a constant of the code | TSD S5 T3.2; FSD S5 BR-S5-006 |
| BR8 | No personal data in a schema, an example or a fake: identifiers, codes, amounts, dates and a rule version only | Architecture v5 slide 42 notes; Template and Rules §R7.2 (s17) |
| BR9 | One REST base, one topic, one queue and one login per service; the document never declares another service's base or topic as its own | DP-13; Template and Rules §R4 |
| BR10 | A schema change is additive within major version 1; a breaking change is a new major version | Architecture v5 slide 42 notes |
| BR11 | The document lists only operations owned by rwb-asset; a consumed operation is described as consumed and faked, never as provided | Ownership Map; DP-11 |
| BR12 | No event is declared: the balance changes on the read after a take-on, and the topic `rwb.asset.events.v1` carries the take-on and sale events of the sibling stories only | Architecture v5 slide 19 OUT; ASM-4745 |

##### 9. State transitions

The lifecycle of this document, not of an asset or of a figure:

| From | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Draft | Review opened | The two reads, the balance element, the confirmation, the consumed rows and the fakes are described | In review |
| In review | Consumer sign-off | The app story, the two screens, the reporting reader, the wave 2 harness and the rwb-source-data, rwb-case and rwb-access owners accept the document and the fakes | Baselined |
| Baselined | Additive change | A property is added within major version 1, for example a new filter or an optional balance grouping | Baselined |
| Baselined | Breaking change | A property is removed, renamed or retyped, a list value changes, or the confirmation path is fixed and differs from the placeholder | New major version drafted |
| Baselined | Drift in a fake | A contract test fails | In review |
| Baselined | A forbidden element appears | The absence tests of AC4 and AC5 fail: a `v_ace_*` view, a `recovery_case` property, an event, a second topic, a Schedule or a balance table | In review |

The figure states the document describes are the app story's: live, shown and confirmed, with the confirmed figure kept as its as-at figure after a take-on. This baseline fixes the vocabulary and the shape and confirms no figure.

##### 11. Data

The contract baseline declares shapes, not business values.

| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| Balance element | `scope` (`LOV-SEGMENT`), `asAtDate`, `ownerRole`, `count`, `bookValueTotal`, `holdingCostTotal` per `holding_status`, `recordRef`, `ruleId`, `ruleVersion` — GAP-2861; ASM-4745 |
| Confirmation request | `StockBalanceConfirmation`: `scope`, `asAtDate`, `officerRef`; all three required; no amount, price or limit as a default |
| Asset element | The columns of DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042 that the read shows: `id`, `case_id`, `asset_ref`, `asset_code`, `asset_type`, `transfer_in_type`, `from_segment`, `transfer_in_date`, `repossessed_date`, `stock_date`, `book_value`, `holding_status`, `holding_cost_to_date` |
| Lists | `LOV-HOLDING`, `LOV-SEGMENT`, `LOV-ASSET-TYPE` and `LOV-TRANSFER-IN`, published as enumerations and read as reference data at their version |
| Decision record | DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-018 through the local library, written before the figure is confirmed (DP-03) |
| ACE asset fact | DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219 of `v_ace_npa_asset` in P1, read only through the owner's data product and never written, copied or joined here |
| Not declared here | `recovery_case` and `assignment` (P3), `proceeds` (P8), `document` (P5), `decision_log_entry` and `rule_row` (P7), `asset_sale` (S5, the sale stories'), and the `v_ace_*` views (P1) |
| Consumed fields with no source | The operation names of the rwb-source-data read and the confirmation path: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2861; ASM-4743, ASM-4746) |

The field-level types, lengths and required flags of the added elements are settled in the baseline review; this story fixes the element names, the vocabulary of AC2 and the optionality rule of BR10. **No new table, no new column and no migration** is declared by this story, and no balance table exists in any source (GAP-2861; ASM-4745).

##### 12. Contract

###### 12.1 REST operations provided

Owner rwb-asset (S5); base `/api/recovery/asset/v1` (DP-13).

| Method | Path | Documented shape | Access | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/assets` | AssetPage out, carrying the `AssetStockBalance` element, filtered by type, status, region, page and size (API-S5-001) | Asset and disposal, right R, scope applied | Not declared |
| GET | `/assets/{assetId}` | Asset of status 200 out, with its holding status, book value, cost to date and listing references (API-S5-002) | Asset and disposal, right R, scope applied | Not declared |
| POST | Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2861; ASM-4743) | `StockBalanceConfirmation` in, `AssetStockBalance` out with its record reference | Asset and disposal, right C, scope applied | `Idempotency-Key` header |

The operations answer 400, 401, 403 with MSG-P4-002, 404, 409 for a repeated confirmation without the key, 422 with MSG-GEN-001 and 503, each with the error envelope and one message ID of section 14. The two read operation IDs are those of TSD S5 T-A.1 and the paths are those of the target base, not the monolith form. API-S5-003 `POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations` is rwb-valuation's under the Ownership Map ruling ASM-0043, and API-S5-004 and API-S5-005 belong to the pricing and auction stories of this service; `GET /assets/{assetKey}` is the key read of the same list and is not declared here. The confirmation has no operation in the FSD endpoint list, the TSD inventory or the Ownership Map, which is why its path is a placeholder (GAP-2861; ASM-4743).

###### 12.2 REST operations consumed

| Method | Path | Owner | Use in the baseline |
|---|---|---|---|
| The read of DP06 Collateral and assets (operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2861; ASM-4746)) | `/api/recovery/source-data/v1` | P1 rwb-source-data | The ACE NPA asset fact of the displayed asset: asset reference, asset code, asset type, transfer-in type, segment, taken-on date, book value and the freshness stamp; faked |
| `GET /cases/{caseId}` family (read) | `/api/recovery/case/v1` | P3 rwb-case | The case state, the case reference and the account link of the asset row; faked |
| The case-move answer (operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2861; ASM-4746)) | rwb-case (P3) | P3 rwb-case | The move `ASSET_ON_BOOKS` with the rule ID and its version, applied by the parent `CaseWorkflow` on the sibling's outcome; declared here as consumed for the two take-on criteria of the app story; faked |

Every row is one hop with a 2 s timeout, a GET retried once with jitter and a breaker per downstream (ADR-020). The three rows are contract dependencies of class C that the plan's C row does not carry, and the absence is recorded as GAP-2861 with ASM-4746.

###### 12.3 Events published

None. The balance is a computed answer of this service's own rows and the confirmation writes a decision record; Architecture v5 slide 19 OUT gives `rwb.asset.events.v1` to `AssetTakenOn` and `AssetSold`, which belong to the take-on and sale stories. This baseline declares no event, no event name of its own and no outbox row, and the absence test of AC5 fails a build that adds one (BR12).

###### 12.4 Events consumed

None. The balance needs no message: it is read on demand and recomputed from the rows. This baseline therefore declares no consumer group, no subscription and no inbox, and no Kafka call of this feature (BR12).

###### 12.5 Workflows and activities

| Name | Type | Task queue | Contract element |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AssetDisposalWorkflow` | Workflow, one execution per case per stage, the child of `CaseWorkflow`, continues-as-new | `rwb-asset` in namespace `rwb-recovery` | The stage that hosts the confirmation step; its signals and its outcome are declared by the sibling story, not redefined here |
| `confirmStockBalance` | Activity, the one confirmation step | `rwb-asset` | In: the scope, the as-at date and the officer reference. Out: the confirmed `AssetStockBalance`, the record reference and the rule version |

No child workflow and no activity is registered by this story. The activity name is a target design choice and the confirmation is a human task of the officer, so it runs on the officer's action and not on a timer; the read is a query and is not a workflow step.

###### 12.6 Schedules

None. The baseline declares no Temporal Schedule, no Quartz row and no shared job table, and no Job of Architecture v5 slide 44 is owned or moved here. JOB-19 Re-appraisal monthly is the service's single Schedule and belongs to RWB-S5-E3026-APP.

###### 12.7 Tables owned

| Table | Owner | Contracted use |
|---|---|---|
| asset | S5 (`rwb_asset`) | The taken-on assets the balance counts: the columns of §11, read only by this feature |
| listing | S5 (`rwb_asset`) | The listing and its sale status shown next to a listed asset; read only |
| decision_record | PLT library, created in `rwb_asset` | The local hash-linked record of the confirmed figure (DP-03) |
| idempotency_key | PLT library, created in `rwb_asset` | The key of the repeated confirmation and the answer it holds |

`recovery_case` and `assignment` (P3), `proceeds` (P8), `document` (P5), `decision_log_entry` and `rule_row` (P7), `asset_sale` (S5, the sale stories') and every `v_ace_*` view (P1) are not owned by this baseline; it names them only as answers, rule versions or a later story's table. No balance table is declared by any source, and a baseline that adds one fails the boundary test (GAP-2861; ASM-4745).

###### 12.8 Contract fakes

| Fake | Documented answer | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| rwb-source-data data-product fake | The ACE NPA asset `AST-2026-000524` with transfer-in date `2026-11-20` and book value `4500000.00`; a stale product with its date; no answer beyond 2 s; an unreadable answer | AC4, AC5 |
| rwb-case state and move fake | The states `ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON`, `ASSET_ON_BOOKS` and `ASSET_HELD` of case `RC-2026-000524`; an accepted move and a refused move | AC4, AC5 |
| rwb-access role fake | RW-NPAMGR with CRU, RW-HEADNPA with RA and a role without the right, each with its scope | AC2, AC3, AC5 |
| rwb-decision rule-package fake | The DISPOSAL package at its version in force with R-DIS-01, R-DIS-02 and R-DIS-03 | AC2, AC5 |
| Local decision-record library stub (`RWB-PLT-E1027-CON`) | A healthy chain and a stopped chain | AC5 |
| gateway-bff composite route fake | The merged SCR-21 and SCR-22 answer for case `RC-2026-000524` | AC1, AC5 |
| Asset-row fixture set | Three `asset` rows of the same scope in `HELD`, `LISTED` and `SOLD` with their book values and costs, producing one count and two totals per status | AC2 |

The fakes are test-only and are replaced by the real services in SIT. The operation names of the rwb-source-data read, of the case-move answer and of the confirmation are derived from the published documents or designed here and carry the placeholder until their owners confirm them (GAP-2861; ASM-4743, ASM-4746).

###### 12.9 Call-type summary

| Call type | Count | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| REST | 3 provided, 3 consumed | The balance, the asset and the confirmation on `/api/recovery/asset/v1`; the rwb-source-data data-product read, the rwb-case state read and the case-move answer; one hop, 2 s |
| Kafka | 0 published, 0 consumed | No event is declared by this baseline |
| Temporal | 1 workflow and 1 activity declared, 0 registered | `AssetDisposalWorkflow` and `confirmStockBalance` on `rwb-asset`; no Schedule |
| File | None | No file is read, built or delivered here |

##### 13. Solution plan

**The CON declares shapes and moves nothing.** It writes no code, no migration and no table, and it changes no asset, no case and no rule package. What it publishes is one OpenAPI 3.1 document, nine contract tables and seven fakes.

**Deliverables.** The additive document `openapi/rwb-asset-v1.yaml`, the `AssetStockBalance`, `StockBalanceConfirmation` and `Asset` elements, the vocabulary of the four lists as published enumerations, the contract README rows for the consumed rows and the confirmation path with their placeholders, and the seven WireMock mapping sets.

**Pattern application**

| DP | Legacy marker | Microservice pattern | Dependency added |
|---|---|---|---|
| DP-03 | DecisionLogWriter, decision log | Local decision-record library and topic `rwb.decision-record.v1` | H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON |
| DP-05 | AceSourceQuery, `v_ace_*`, account_ext | Read through rwb-source-data's contract or the service's own ACE views | none |
| DP-13 | `/api/recovery/v1` | `/api/recovery/<short>/v1` | none |
| DP-19 | Screen, ace-web | gateway-bff composite route | H RWB-PLT-N001-CON |

DP-05 is declared as a prohibition here: the document declares no `v_ace_*` path, no `v_ace_*` property and no grant on any other owner's schema, because rwb-asset holds none (Architecture v5 slides 29, 37 and 45; ASM-4746). DP-13 moves the base and nothing else. DP-19 is behind SCR-21 and SCR-22, whose screen model is the edge contract's. DP-03 is the element rule of the confirmation.

**Dependencies the table adds and the plan does not hold.** The pattern table adds the two H rows the plan already carries for this key and no other; the three consumed rows are C dependencies in fact and not in the metadata row (GAP-2861; ASM-4746), and no event library is added because no event is declared.

**Build steps**

1. Write the two reads and validate the additive rule of AC1 in the pipeline.
2. Write the `AssetStockBalance` element, its owner and as-at fields and its four lists of AC2 with the placeholder where a type is unstated.
3. Write the `StockBalanceConfirmation` request and the confirmation operation of AC3 with its path placeholder, its rights and its idempotency.
4. Record the consumed rwb-source-data and rwb-case rows of AC4 with their owner, budget, freshness stamp and placeholder.
5. Record the decision-record element of AC5 and validate it against the library schema.
6. Publish the seven fakes of AC5 and the drift test.
7. Record the naming baseline and the boundary of AC5, then tag the baseline and collect the consumer sign-off.

**Done when.** The OpenAPI document validates in the pipeline, the four contract tests pass, the fakes answer every consumed path and the drift test is green, and the app story, the two screens, the reporting reader and the wave 2 harness have accepted the baseline.

##### 14. Validation and messages

| ID | When | Message |
|---|---|---|
| MSG-GEN-001 | A required field of the confirmation is absent or invalid, or a body fails schema validation | Enter {field}. |
| MSG-P4-002 | The role lacks the Asset and disposal right the operation declares, or the scope excludes the segment | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. |
| MSG-P7-003 | The decision record cannot be written before the figure is confirmed | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. |
| MSG-P1-001 | The ACE data product of the displayed asset is stale after a late or failed batch (VR-S5-006-1); the check is the owner's and this service holds no ACE batch status read | {product} is from {date}. Today's ACE batch has not arrived. |
| MSG-S5-001 | Carried from the legacy message set of this key. It names the floor percentage and the approval limit, which are the pricing story's, so no operation of this baseline raises it | The floor is {pct} of fair market value, below the {limit} this level may approve. |
| MSG-S5-002 | Carried from the legacy message set of this key. It names the age of an appraisal, which is the re-appraisal story's, so no operation of this baseline raises it | The appraisal is from {date}, more than a year ago. Order a new one before pricing. |

The six message IDs are contract elements and the text is the legacy and FSD wording, copied unchanged; no message is reworded and no new one is added. MSG-P1-001 is carried because it is in the message set of the feature, and the check itself belongs to rwb-source-data (GAP-2861; ASM-4746).

##### 15. Screens and states

The contract serves SCR-21 Asset list in its loading and list states and SCR-22 Asset record in its take-on, held, listed and sold states, all through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19). The route calls rwb-asset for the balance and the asset, rwb-case for the case and its route state and rwb-source-data for the ACE asset fact; this baseline fixes the rwb-asset answers only, and the composite route specification and the screen field list belong to RWB-PLT-N001-CON. The figure states of the app story — live, shown, confirmed, refused, not recorded, invalid and unavailable — read the messages of section 14 on the same route.

##### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in the contract: the lists, the rule rows, the segment scopes and the one-working-day targets stay data, reference data or the rule package, never a schema default or an enumeration member of the code.
- No personal data in a schema, an example or a fake: identifiers, codes, amounts, dates and a rule version only, and the owner field is a role code and never a person; every example is synthetic.
- The ACE asset fact stays with rwb-source-data and the case with rwb-case: the document declares no `v_ace_*` path, no `recovery_case` or `assignment` property, no case row write and no ACE table read (BR3, BR4).
- The money stays with rwb-payment and the sale status with the sale stories: the document declares no posting, no balance amount of rwb-payment and no price.
- One base, one topic, one queue and one login per service; a document that names another service's base or topic as its own fails the review (DP-13).
- The document lists only operations owned by rwb-asset; a consumed operation is described as consumed and faked, never as provided (BR11).
- No retired element is reintroduced: the absence tests fail a build that declares an event, a second topic, a Schedule, a Quartz row, a shared job table or a balance table.
- The error envelope, the `Idempotency-Key` rule, the naming rule and the decision-record library come from the platform; this story narrows them but never redefines them.

**Change log.** D-RCV-60, 22 November 2026: the application slice of RWB-E3-024 split out for rwb-asset. The four legacy acceptance criteria are kept word for word with their origin tag; the feature now gives the stock balance one accountable owner and one number on SCR-21 and SCR-22, computed from the `asset` rows of `rwb_asset` and confirmed by a step of `AssetDisposalWorkflow` on task queue `rwb-asset`, with the confirmation written to the local decision record before the balance is shown as confirmed (DP-03). The legacy `v_ace_npa_asset` and `v_ace_account` reads are retired as service reads because rwb-asset holds no ACE view grant, so the ACE asset fact arrives on the rwb-source-data data-product contract (DP-05); the base becomes `/api/recovery/asset/v1` (DP-13); SCR-21 and SCR-22 read through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19). The take-on routes of R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 are built by the sibling stories of this service and are carried here because the legacy key restates them (GAP-2860; ASM-4737). Tool: T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash.

##### 1. Story

As an **NPA and asset manager (RW-NPAMGR)**, I want **the asset stock balance to have one accountable owner and one number on one screen, and every take-on of an asset to move that number**, so that **the bank stops keeping the NPA stock balance in hand-checked listings and floor prices across several owners and the 1,486-day NPA sales cycle moves to the 1,095-day target**.

This is the application slice of legacy RWB-E3-024. It owns:

- the four legacy acceptance criteria of the story, copied verbatim with their origin tag, and the messages, screens and rules they depend on;
- the stock-balance figure: for a scope and an as-at date, the count of assets held and the totals of `book_value` and `holding_cost_to_date` of the `asset` rows, grouped by `holding_status`, computed from `rwb_asset` and never stored in a second table (GAP-2860; ASM-4737);
- the accountable owner of the balance: the RW-NPAMGR role of FSD S5 A2.6.3.3, shown on the screen with the figure and with the as-at date, and read from the role matrix of rwb-access — never a person (BR7);
- the confirmation step `confirmStockBalance` of `AssetDisposalWorkflow` on queue `rwb-asset`: the officer task that confirms the figure for a scope and an as-at date;
- the local decision record of the confirmation, written through RWB-PLT-E1027-CON before the figure is shown as confirmed (DP-03);
- the two reads of SCR-21 Asset list and SCR-22 Asset record on base `/api/recovery/asset/v1`, reached through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-13, DP-19).

It does not own: the published shape of the two reads and of the confirmation, the `AssetStockBalance` element, the consumed rows, the error set and the fakes, which are RWB-S5-E3024-CON; the creation of the `asset` row under R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02, which is RWB-S5-E3019-APP and RWB-S5-E3020-APP, and the LED route of R-DIS-03, which is RWB-S5-E3021-APP; the holding clocks and the provision steps of R-DIS-06, which are RWB-S5-E3023-APP; the case of record, its route states and the parent `CaseWorkflow`, which are rwb-case (P3); the ACE NPA asset, collateral and account facts, which are rwb-source-data's (P1); the decision ledger rows and the rule rows, which are rwb-decision's (P7); the document and its custody, which are rwb-document's (P5); the money and any posting, which are rwb-payment's (P8); and the deployment of this build, which is the operations story of this legacy key and the wave 2 harness.

The word "owns" above needs one qualification, and it is the same one the sibling story RWB-S5-E3020-APP records: the legacy masters give the same R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 criteria to more than one story. This story keeps them word for word because the legacy key RWB-E3-024 lists them, and the write path they describe is the sibling stories' — what this story builds and proves is the balance those writes move (GAP-2860; ASM-4737).

##### 2. Business rationale

Legacy RWB-E3-024 gave the Workbench one screen that would give the stock balance an owner and a number "on one screen. It has no owner today" (FSD S5 A2.6.1). The problem statement of the module is unchanged: the NPA sales cycle is 1,486 days and listings and floor prices are checked by hand; the metric is the same, measured on the decision log and the Workbench records, reviewed monthly, moving from 1,486 days to 1,095 days (FSD S5 A1.3 and A2.6.1).

What D-RCV-60 changes is who holds the figure and where it comes from. In the monolith the stock balance was read across the `recovery` schema, with `v_ace_account`, `v_ace_npa_asset` and the case in one query under one owner. In the target:

- **the figure is this service's.** `asset` is S5's table in `rwb_asset` with the holding status, the book value and the holding cost to date (TSD S5 T3.1; the `asset` row is absent from the Ownership Map table list and is read as S5 from Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1 — GAP-2860; ASM-4737), so the balance is a projection of this service's own rows and needs no cross-service join (DP-01).
- **the ACE asset fact stays with rwb-source-data (P1).** The legacy data table names `v_ace_npa_asset` and `v_ace_account`; in the target only rwb-source-data reads the 30 `recovery.v_ace_*` views (Architecture v5 slides 29, 37 and 45) and the S5 row of slide 13 names no call to P1, so DP-05 applies as a **prohibition** and the fact arrives on the owner's data-product contract (FSD P1 DP06 Collateral and assets — GAP-2860; ASM-4740).
- **the owner is a role, not a person.** FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 makes the NPA and asset manager the primary role of the feature and the Head of NPA the also-user; TSD S5 T6.1 gives both the Asset and disposal rights. The "owner" column of the balance is therefore a role code with scope, and no name of a person enters the figure, the decision record or a log (Template and Rules §R7.2 s17).
- **the decision is recorded first**, through the local decision-record library of DP-03 in the same transaction as the confirmation, which is what legacy AC1 asks for and what legacy AC4 tests.
- **the number is one deterministic figure.** Two officers on two screens on the same business date confirm the same figure from the same rows, so the count and the totals cannot differ between owners; the as-at date travels with the figure.

The case state and the take-on are unchanged and stay with their owners: the route states `ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON` and `ASSET_ON_BOOKS` are rwb-case's, written on the answer of the sibling take-on stories, and this story only counts the rows those answers produce. Nothing of the metric, of the `LOV-HOLDING` and `LOV-SEGMENT` values or of the one-working-day targets of R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 becomes a constant of this build: they are reference data and rule rows, read with their version.

##### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-S5-E3024-CON is published: the `AssetStockBalance` element, the confirmation request and answer, the two reads, the consumed rows, the `Idempotency-Key` rule, the error set and the fakes are baselined and handed to this story.
- RWB-PLT-E1027-CON is published with its writer fake: the local decision-record library writes in the caller's transaction and a failed write stops the action with MSG-P7-003, so the confirmation and its record commit together or not at all (DP-03).
- RWB-PLT-N001-CON is published: SCR-21 and SCR-22 reach this service through the gateway-bff composite route, one hop each, and no screen calls a service directly (DP-19).
- The rwb-source-data data-product contract of DP06 Collateral and assets is published with its fake, so the ACE asset fact behind the displayed asset can be read on Day 1. Its operation name is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2860; ASM-4740), and the row is not in this story's contract-dependency list, which is None.
- The rwb-case case-state read and the case-move answer are available for the fake. No source names a published operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage; on the workflow boundary the answer is the stage outcome the parent `CaseWorkflow` applies (GAP-2860; ASM-4737).
- The role matrix of rwb-access carries RW-NPAMGR and RW-HEADNPA with the Asset and disposal rights TSD S5 T6.1 gives them, so the owner shown on the screen is a role code the access service can resolve (GAP-2860; ASM-4739).
- `asset` and `listing` exist in schema `rwb_asset` from the DB story of this service, with the columns of DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042 and DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-008 and the standard record columns of TSD S5 T3.0; this story adds no table, no column and no migration (GAP-2860; ASM-4741).
- The DISPOSAL rule package is in force at its version with R-DIS-01, R-DIS-02 and R-DIS-03; the package is authored, tested and approved in rwb-decision (P7) and loaded here on `RulePackageInForce`. The rule rows themselves are governed there and are not created by this story.
- The service runs as its own login on schema `rwb_asset`; it holds no grant on another `rwb_*` schema and no `v_ace_*` grant, so a statement on `recovery.v_ace_npa_asset`, `recovery.v_ace_account` or `rwb_case` is refused by the database and fails the boundary test (DP-05).
- No approval is needed to build against a Draft contract baseline; the contract is tagged by RWB-S5-E3024-CON when its tests pass.

##### 4. Flow

1. An asset is taken on by the step of RWB-S5-E3019-APP (R-DIS-01), RWB-S5-E3020-APP (R-DIS-02) or RWB-S5-E3021-APP (R-DIS-03): the `asset` row is inserted in `rwb_asset` with its `holding_status` of `LOV-HOLDING`, its `book_value` and its dates. This story writes no part of that row and adds no second take-on path.
2. The NPA and asset manager opens SCR-21 Asset list or SCR-22 Asset record through the gateway-bff composite route; the route asks rwb-asset for the balance and for the asset rows, rwb-case for the case and its route state, and rwb-source-data for the ACE asset fact (DP-19).
3. `AssetStockBalanceQuery` reads the `asset` rows of the scope in force from `rwb_asset` only, and groups them by `holding_status` (`HELD`, `LISTED`, `UNDER_OFFER`, `SOLD`, `TRANSFERRED`, `RENTED` of `LOV-HOLDING`): the count of assets, the sum of `book_value` (DF-COL-037) and the sum of `holding_cost_to_date` (DF-COL-042), with the as-at date and the segment scope of `LOV-SEGMENT` (GAP-2860; ASM-4737).
4. The answer names the accountable owner as the role code RW-NPAMGR with its scope, resolved from the role matrix, and never as a person (FSD S5 A2.6.3.3; GAP-2860; ASM-4739).
5. The officer confirms the figure for the scope and the as-at date; the confirmation step `confirmStockBalance` of `AssetDisposalWorkflow` on queue `rwb-asset` receives it. Where the read is taken between two take-ons, the figure is the one of the rows in the transaction the read sees, and the as-at date makes the difference visible.
6. `StockBalanceEvaluator` reads the DISPOSAL package version in force from rwb-decision and resolves the rule set of the confirmation (R-DIS-01, R-DIS-02 and R-DIS-03 are in the package of the same stage) with the balance inputs, so the record names the rule and the version that were in force when the figure was confirmed.
7. `StockBalanceDecisionRecordWriter` writes one decision record through the local decision-record library **before any change** (DP-03): the scope, the as-at date, the count, the two totals, the owner role, the rule ID with its version, the inputs reference and the outcome. A failed write changes nothing and the officer sees MSG-P7-003 (legacy AC4).
8. `AssetStockBalance` answers the confirmation with the confirmed figure, its owner, its as-at date and the record reference, and writes the idempotency row so that a repeated confirmation of the same scope and date writes no second record.
9. SCR-21 and SCR-22 show the confirmed figure next to the live figure of the read, the as-at date and the owner, with the loading, list and record states of FSD S5 A2.6 (`Loading; list` on SCR-21 and `Take-on; held; listed; sold` on SCR-22).
10. A take-on by a sibling story changes the live figure on the next read; nothing is pushed and no event is published by this story, so a stale screen shows its as-at date rather than a wrong number.
11. A repeated request with the same `Idempotency-Key`, or a confirmation of the same scope and as-at date twice, writes one record and answers once.

##### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | The local decision record cannot be written | The transaction writes nothing: no confirmation, no record and no answer leaves the service | MSG-P7-003 | AC4, TC-E3-024-04, TC-E3-024-06 |
| X2 | The role does not hold the Asset and disposal right of the operation, or the scope excludes the segment | 403 before any read or write; the figure is not shown and no record is written | MSG-P4-002 | AC1, TC-E3-024-05 |
| X3 | A required field of the confirmation is absent or invalid (scope, as-at date, owner) | 422 and nothing is written | MSG-GEN-001 | AC1, TC-E3-024-01 |
| X4 | The as-at date is later than the business date in force | The confirmation is refused with the error envelope and nothing is written; the date is not raised as a business value | MSG-GEN-001 | AC1 |
| X5 | The ACE data product is stale after a late or failed batch | The asset fact of the displayed asset shows its date and the balance keeps its own as-at date; the confirmation is not blocked by a stale ACE batch, and the staleness is shown on the record screen | MSG-P1-001 | AC1 |
| X6 | The rwb-source-data or rwb-case contract does not answer inside 2 s, or its breaker is open | The screen shows the balance from this service's rows with the case and ACE parts marked unavailable; the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope and nothing is written | None | AC1, AC2 |
| X7 | The asked scope has no `asset` row | 200 with a count of zero and empty totals, with the owner and the as-at date; no record is written until the officer confirms | None | AC1 |
| X8 | A component, a statement or a test reaches a `v_ace_*` view, a `recovery_case` row, a `recovery.assignment` row or another service's schema | The grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build; nothing is released | None (pipeline log) | Section 17, BR3, BR5 |

X1 and X2 are the exception paths of RWB-E3-024 carried onto the split (`Statement` and `Access` in the legacy test cases), X3 to X7 are the paths the target read and the confirmation add, and X8 is the DP-05 and DP-01 boundary. The one-working-day targets of R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 and the 12-month appraisal age of MSG-S5-002 stay values in force and are not constants of this story.

##### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Starts on Day 1 against RWB-S5-E3024-CON, the rwb-source-data and rwb-case fakes, the access role fake and the decision-record stub, on its own schema, and needs no live P1, P3 or P7 |
| Negotiable | The query and activity names, the decision code and the element names beyond the sources are this story's choice; the rules, the messages, the screens, the reads and the lists are fixed |
| Valuable | One owner and one number for the stock balance, with the as-at date and the decision recorded, on the screens the officers already use |
| Estimable | One query, one evaluator, one confirmation step, one record write, two reads, three clients and two screen fragments |
| Small | Finished inside two weeks with its tests on the fakes |
| Testable | Each criterion runs on synthetic assets and ACE facts through the contract fakes, plus the component cases of the refusal and the failed record write |

```gherkin
  Scenario: AC3 Rule R-DIS-02 (legacy RWB-E3-024 AC3)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns the AMIS deed in lieu transfer of property "AST-2026-000524" with the opening book value "4500000.00"
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON" for "RC-2026-000524"
    Given a case in state ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON
    When dil transfer registered
    Then create the asset record from AMIS with the opening book value
    Then the case moves to ASSET_ON_BOOKS

  Scenario: AC4 Not recorded (legacy RWB-E3-024 AC4)
    Given the decision log cannot be written
    When the action is taken
    Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
```

The four criteria are the legacy criteria of RWB-E3-024 word for word, with their origin tag added and nothing else changed: the repetition of `Then`, the legacy wording of `the user acts on the screen`, `It has no owner today`, `the action is taken` and `the decision log cannot be written` all stand, and the sentence of AC1 keeps its place inside `Then`. The cross-service parts are mocked, so AC1, AC2 and AC3 each carry one or two `Given the <service> contract mock returns <x>` lines, and those added `Given` lines are the only additions to the legacy text; the values they carry are synthetic fixtures and change no legacy value.

What the legacy lines describe happens in three places in the target. rwb-source-data answers the ACE asset fact of the take-on; the take-on step of RWB-S5-E3019-APP or RWB-S5-E3020-APP writes the `asset` row and the sibling answers the case move to rwb-case; and this story reads the `asset` rows, computes the count and the two totals, resolves the owner and writes the confirmation record. Two notes are recorded rather than smoothed over. AC2 and AC3 are the criteria that legacy RWB-E3-019 and RWB-E3-020 also carry, because the legacy masters duplicate the take-on rules across stories; this story keeps its copy word for word and proves it on the balance the take-on moves, while the write path itself is the sibling's (GAP-2860; ASM-4737). AC1 says the screen gives "a number"; no source says which figure that number is, so the count of assets held with the totals of book value and holding cost to date is the default, recorded as an assumption (GAP-2860; ASM-4737).

##### 8. Business rules

| Rule | Route set | Decision | From state | Event | Condition | Action | To state | Owner | Systems | Timer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-DIS-01 | Asset disposal | D8.1 to D8.3 | ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON | REPOSSESSION_COMPLETED | asset_type = vehicle and statutory_notice_proved = Y | Create the asset record from RPS with condition, photographs and location | ASSET_ON_BOOKS | Sale officer | RPS, AMIS, Field App | 1 working day |
| R-DIS-02 | Asset disposal | D8.1 to D8.3 | ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON | DIL_TRANSFER_REGISTERED | asset_type = property and transfer registered | Create the asset record from AMIS with the opening book value | ASSET_ON_BOOKS | Sale officer | AMIS, the Land Office | 1 working day |
| VR-S5-006-1 | Asset disposal | None | Any | The confirmation is submitted | Required field empty | Refuse the request with MSG-GEN-001 | Unchanged | NPA and asset manager | Workbench | None |

The two rule rows are the rows of the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4, copied character for character; VR-S5-006-1 is the validation rule of FSD S5 A2.6.3.1 and has no message of its own beyond MSG-GEN-001. Their owner column is a role of the business and not a service: the case moves of `ASSET_ON_BOOKS` are written by rwb-case on the sibling's answer, the `asset` row is written by the sibling step, and this story reads the row and records the confirmation. R-DIS-03 is in the rule set of the feature (FSD S5 A2.6.3.1) and belongs to RWB-S5-E3021-APP; it is not tabled here because no criterion of this key names it.

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | The stock balance is computed from the `asset` rows of `rwb_asset` alone: the count, the sum of `book_value` and the sum of `holding_cost_to_date`, grouped by `holding_status`, for a scope and an as-at date, and it is stored in no second table | TSD S5 T3.1 and T3.2; Architecture v5 slide 41; DP-01; GAP-2860; ASM-4737 |
| BR2 | The confirmation is recorded before the figure is shown as confirmed, with the rule ID and the package version in force; a failed write changes nothing and the caller sees MSG-P7-003 | DP-03; TSD S5 T2 ("writes the decision log entry before any change"); legacy RWB-E3-024 AC1 and AC4 |
| BR3 | The ACE asset and account facts stay with rwb-source-data: this story reads no `v_ace_*` view and no ACE table, and takes the fact on the owner's data-product contract only | DP-05; Architecture v5 slides 29, 37 and 45; GAP-2860; ASM-4740 |
| BR4 | The case, its route states and its assignment are rwb-case's: this story reads the case state on its contract and writes no `recovery_case` and no `assignment` row | Ownership Map (recovery_case and assignment owner P3); GAP-2860; ASM-4737 |
| BR5 | No cross-schema join and no foreign key leaves `rwb_asset`; `case_id` and `collateral_id` of an `asset` row are identifiers of other services' facts | DP-01; TSD S5 T3.3 |
| BR6 | The owner of the balance is a role code with a scope and never a person; the figure, the record, the log and the answer carry identifiers, codes, amounts, dates and a rule version only | Template and Rules §R7.2 (s17); TSD S5 T6.1; FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 |
| BR7 | Every value a business person may change is reference data or a rule row read with its version: `LOV-HOLDING`, `LOV-SEGMENT`, `LOV-ASSET-TYPE`, `LOV-TRANSFER-IN` and the rule rows of the DISPOSAL package | TSD S5 T3.2; FSD S5 BR-S5-006 |
| BR8 | The same confirmation twice, or the same `Idempotency-Key` twice, writes one record and answers once | TSD S5 T-A.2; Architecture v5 slide 11 |
| BR9 | This story publishes no event and consumes none: the balance changes on the read after a take-on, and no consumer group, subscription or inbox is created | Architecture v5 slide 19 IN and OUT; GAP-2860; ASM-4742 |

##### 9. State transitions

The case route state is rwb-case's and is not changed by this story: the move `ASSET_ON_BOOKS` is answered by the sibling take-on story and applied to the case of record by the parent `CaseWorkflow` (BR4). What this story owns is the state of the figure and the state of the confirmation.

| Figure state | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Live | A take-on writes an `asset` row | Any holding status of `LOV-HOLDING` | Live, with a new count and new totals on the next read |
| Live | The officer opens SCR-21 or SCR-22 | The role holds Asset and disposal R and the scope covers the segment | Shown with the owner and the as-at date |
| Shown | The officer confirms the figure | The request is valid and the record is written | Confirmed, with its record reference and as-at date |
| Confirmed | A later take-on writes an `asset` row | Any | Live again, with the confirmed figure kept as the previous as-at figure |
| Shown | The record cannot be written | X1 | Unchanged, nothing confirmed |
| Any | The contract of rwb-source-data or rwb-case does not answer inside 2 s | X6 | Shown from this service's rows only, with the case and ACE parts marked unavailable |

| Confirmation execution | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Waiting | The officer submits a scope and an as-at date | The role and the scope check passes | Validating |
| Validating | The required fields are present and the date is not in the future | X3, X4 do not fire | Deciding |
| Deciding | The package in force is loaded and the rule set resolves | The record is written | Confirmed |
| Confirmed | The transaction commits | The idempotency row and the record are written | Waiting for the next confirmation |

The holding status values are those of `LOV-HOLDING` in TSD S5 T3.2 and the segment values those of `LOV-SEGMENT`; the figure has no state of its own in any source, so the three states above are this story's design and are recorded as such (GAP-2860; ASM-4742).

##### 10. Authority

| Who | What they may do in this story |
|---|---|
| RW-NPAMGR, NPA and asset manager | Asset and disposal CRU in TSD S5 T6.1: the primary role of the feature and the accountable owner of the balance; confirms the figure for a scope and an as-at date |
| RW-HEADNPA, Head of NPA | Asset and disposal RA: reads the balance and approves where the figure is taken to the head of NPA; confirms through the approval path where the officer's scope does not cover the segment |
| RW-SALEOFF, sale officer | Asset and disposal CRUA: reads the balance and the asset rows of its own scope |
| RW-ENFORCE, enforcement owner | Asset and disposal CRU: reads the balance of the enforcement assets |
| RW-CASEOWN, RW-TEAMMGR, RW-FIELDCOL, RW-COMPLAIN, RW-LITOFF, RW-LEGAL, RW-DEBTSALE, RW-WRITEOFF, RW-CREDITAD, RW-AGENCYMG, RW-CONDUCT, RW-PRODHEAD, RW-HEADLIT, RW-HEADASL, RW-RISK, RW-COE, RW-FINANCE, RW-AUDIT, RW-BIANAL, RW-TRIBE | Asset and disposal R: read only, in scope |
| PT-VALUER, PT-AUCTION, PT-RAMC | Asset and disposal R or RU as the TSD S5 T6.1 matrix gives it: a partner reads the assets of its own scope through the partner gateway and never the balance of a segment |
| SY-CASEWF, SY-RULES, SY-DATALOAD, SY-AGENT | Asset and disposal R or C as the matrix gives it: the service identities read and are subject to the same checks |
| rwb-asset service identity | Runs the confirmation step, resolves the rule version, writes the decision record and answers the reads; it holds no grant on another schema and no `v_ace_*` grant |

The rights above are the rows of TSD S5 T6.1 and the capability rows of FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 and nothing wider: the FSD gives Asset and disposal R to RW-CASEOWN, RW-TEAMMGR, RW-FIELDCOL, RW-COMPLAIN, RW-LITOFF, RW-ENFORCE, RW-LEGAL, RW-SALEOFF "and 23 more", and C to RW-ENFORCE, RW-SALEOFF, RW-NPAMGR and SY-DATALOAD, which the matrix covers. DP-08 is not in this story's pattern set: the capability area and the right are declared per operation and the guard is a service-template capability, so the check is stated here and not built here. The owner of the balance is resolved from the role matrix and not from a parameter, because DP-06 is not in the pattern set either (GAP-2860; ASM-4739).

| DF-ACE-001 to DF-ACE-042 | `v_ace_account` (P1) | account_key, account_code, total_balance and 36 more | Not read: listed by the legacy story and owned by P1; no path of this story needs it |
